title.zh: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
title.en: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana

current_state.zh: 第68号提案以99.4%支持和58%参与率通过；交易所须先确认置换，第二次投票才会确定快照、申领和关停时间表，因此关停与迁移仍未执行，验证者继续运行，质押奖励继续发放。
current_state.en: Proposal 68 passed with 99.4% support and 58% participation; exchanges must first confirm the swap before a second vote sets the snapshot, claims, and shutdown schedule, so shutdown and migration remain pending while validators continue operating and staking rewards continue.

updates.title_zh: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
updates.title_en: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
updates.what_changed_zh: ZetaChain token holders voted to shut down the project's Layer 1 network and move the ZETA asset to Solana, with the team pivoting to its private AI app Anuma, though the migration requires one more vote.
updates.what_changed_en: ZetaChain token holders voted to shut down the project's Layer 1 network and move the ZETA asset to Solana, with the team pivoting to its private AI app Anuma, though the migration requires one more vote.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: ZetaChain token holders voted to shut down the project's Layer 1 network and move the ZETA asset to Solana, with the team pivoting to its private AI app Anuma, though the migration requires one more vote.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ZetaChain token holders voted to shut down the project's Layer 1 network and move the ZETA asset to Solana, with the team pivoting to its private AI app Anuma, though the migration requires one more vote.
updates.background_zh: ZetaChain 基于 Cosmos SDK 和 Tendermint 共识构建，并包含一个兼容以太坊虚拟机的执行层 zEVM，定位为支持全链（omnichain）智能合约和跨链消息传递的基础层。Anuma 是同一团队的私密 AI 聊天产品，它会为用户对话建立加密记忆，数据保存在用户设备上并可跨不同 AI 模型使用。Solana 是一条高吞吐量的 Layer 1，SPL 是其原生代币标准，因此 ZETA 迁移意味着在 Solana 上发行该资产并在原链上将其退出。
updates.background_en: ZetaChain was built with the Cosmos SDK and Tendermint consensus and included an Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible execution layer called zEVM, positioning itself as a base layer for omnichain smart contracts and cross-chain messaging between otherwise separate networks. Anuma is the same team's private AI chat product, which builds an encrypted memory of a user's conversations that stays on the user's device and travels across different AI models. Solana is a high-throughput Layer 1, and SPL is its native token standard, so migrating ZETA means issuing the asset on Solana and retiring it on its original chain.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该投票使 ZETA 资产进入链迁移通道，其原链将逐步退出，这会影响上线 ZETA 的交易所的现货流动性与兑换机制，并使验证者及跨链桥相关活动从 ZetaChain 生态中流出。若迁移顺利完成，Solana 生态的代币版图中将新增一枚 SPL 资产，而此次关停本身也会强化市场对小型 Layer 1 网络可持续性的讨论情绪。
updates.market_impact_en: The vote puts the ZETA asset on a path toward a chain migration and the retirement of its original network, which affects spot liquidity and redemption mechanics on exchanges that list ZETA, and shifts validator and bridge-related activity away from the ZetaChain ecosystem. A successful migration would also add another Solana SPL asset to that ecosystem's token universe, while the wind-down itself feeds broader sentiment about the sustainability of smaller Layer 1 networks.

updates.title_zh: ZetaChain 持有人批准逐步关停 L1、将 ZETA 迁移至 Solana 的计划
updates.title_en: ZetaChain holders approve plan to wind down L1, move ZETA to Solana
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增细节：治理提案第68号以99.4%支持和58%参与率通过，超过40%法定人数；ZETA将以1:1兑换为Solana SPL代币并保留代码和总供应量；投票不会立即触发关停或迁移，核心贡献者将提交第二份提案说明提款窗口、快照区块高度、关停时间表、代币申领流程和交易所转换期。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details: governance proposal 68 passed with 99.4% support and 58% participation, exceeding the 40% quorum; ZETA will become a Solana SPL token via 1:1 conversion with same ticker and total supply; the vote does not immediately trigger shutdown or migration, and core contributors will submit a second proposal detailing the withdrawal window, snapshot block height, shutdown timetable, token claim process, and exchange conversion period.
updates.current_state_zh: ZetaChain 代币持有人已通过第68号治理提案，批准逐步关停基于Cosmos的Layer 1并将ZETA迁移至Solana，但不会立即执行；验证者继续运行，质押奖励继续发放，后续仍需第二份提案明确迁移与关停细节。
updates.current_state_en: ZetaChain tokenholders passed governance proposal 68 to wind down the Cosmos-based Layer 1 and migrate ZETA to Solana, but the shutdown and migration will not occur immediately; validators continue operating, staking rewards continue, and a second proposal is still needed to detail the migration and shutdown process.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ZetaChain 代币持有人于周日通过了第 68 号治理提案，以 99.4% 的支持率和 58% 的参与率批准逐步关停其基于 Cosmos 的 layer 1，并按 1:1 兑换将原生 ZETA 迁移为 Solana 上的 SPL 代币，保留相同代币代码和总供应量。根据提案，该投票不会立即触发 ZetaChain 的关停或迁移；核心贡献者将提交第二份提案，详述与其他区块链相关资产的提款窗口、快照区块高度、关停时间表、代币申领流程和交易所转换期，验证者将继续运行，质押奖励在过渡期间继续发放。
updates.detailed_summary_en: ZetaChain tokenholders passed governance proposal 68 on Sunday with 99.4% support and 58% participation, exceeding the network’s 40% quorum, to wind down its Cosmos-based layer 1 and migrate native ZETA to Solana as an SPL token through a 1:1 conversion with the same ticker and total supply. According to the proposal, the vote does not immediately trigger ZetaChain’s shutdown or migration; core contributors will submit a second proposal detailing the withdrawal window for assets linked to other blockchains, snapshot block height, shutdown timetable, token claim process and exchange conversion period, while validators continue operating and staking rewards continue during the transition.
